name: Citizenship by Investment for Commonwealth Citizens

requirements.blocker_text: Restricted to citizens of Commonwealth of Nations member states.
Transfer foreign exchange worth PKR 5,000,000 through official banking channels.
requirements.fix_path: Transfer PKR 5,000,000 (or equivalent) in foreign exchange through the banking system.

evidence_required.document: Proof of foreign exchange transfer via banking channels
State Bank of Pakistan confirmation of transfer
Security clearance (post-arrival, before citizenship certificate is granted)

sources.title: Directorate General of Immigration & Passports, Government of Pakistan -- Grant of Pakistan Citizenship: Section 20 of the Pakistan Citizenship Act 1951, Commonwealth citizens transferring PKR 5,000,000 in foreign exchange through banking channels may be issued an immigrant visa; after State Bank of Pakistan confirmation of the transfer, a citizenship certificate is granted following arrival and security clearance; Form 'R' in quadruplicate

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Pakistan). Published on tier-1 sourcing directly from the government's own citizenship page. GENUINELY DISTINCTIVE MARQUEE ROUTE, RARE OUTSIDE CARIBBEAN CBI STATES (this dataset has previously found a comparable genuine citizenship-by-investment program only in Bangladesh): a straightforward capital-transfer-for-citizenship mechanism, restricted to citizens of OTHER COMMONWEALTH countries only -- a non-Commonwealth investor cannot use this route regardless of capital. At current exchange rates PKR 5,000,000 is a comparatively modest sum (tens of thousands of USD, not hundreds of thousands or millions as in most CBI programs) -- the government source states the threshold only in Pakistani rupees, not USD, so no USD conversion is asserted here as a hard figure since exchange rates move; this is flagged as a genuine open question for a user pricing this route rather than an invented conversion. Distinct from pk_investor_residence.json (the SIFC Investor Visa), which grants residence/entry rights tied to an investment project but does not itself lead to citizenship.
